guidance: One-paragraph summary used on calcofi.io cards and tables; becomes the EML abstract when `abstract` is empty.
Full EML abstract: what the dataset is, why it exists, what is in it. Falls back to `description` when empty.
How the data were collected or measured (instruments, protocols). Markdown; becomes an EML methodStep.
The spatial/temporal/thematic scope actually sampled -- what defines one observation.
The sampling design in prose: gear, frequency, station pattern.
QC steps applied before release (flags, corrections, validation).
Update frequency / ongoing vs. completed / how new data enters the series.
One per line: Name · Organization · orcid · email. The people/orgs who created the dataset.
Other contributors and their role (dataManager, principalInvestigator, ...), same `Name · Org · orcid · email` form as creators.
An email or URL a user can reach about this dataset. Falls back to the CalCOFI role address when empty.
Free-text keywords, one per line or semicolon-separated.
GCMD Science Keywords controlled-vocabulary terms -- what IOOS/NCEI/data.gov facet on.
Funding sources / grant numbers.
Acknowledgement text a use of this data is required or expected to carry.
The canonical how-to-cite string for this dataset.
Other citations relevant to this dataset (companion papers, prior versions), one per line.
An id from metadata/license.csv (CC-BY-4.0, CC0-1.0, US-PD, custom, unknown). `custom` requires license_url.
Required when license = custom: URL to the provider's own terms.
Bare DOI (10.xxxx/...), no https:// prefix, expected to resolve.
Principal investigator name(s), semicolon-separated; superseded by `creators` once populated.
The calcofi.org landing page for this dataset, if any.
The portal/download URL the data is actually fetched from.
Other relevant URLs (companion DOIs, related pages), one per line.
Asserted ONLY when the data provably cannot answer it (see CLAUDE.md 'Coverage is measured, never asserted'); otherwise leave empty -- the release measures it.
